The image shows a stainless steel mixing bowl holding diced cooked chicken or tofu, sliced red onion, and shredded carrot. The bowl looks about 22-25 cm across at the rim. The food pile covers roughly 12 cm and is perhaps 4-5 cm deep.

The pile is about 12 × 12 × 4 cm, or roughly 400 cm³ if solid. With gaps between the pieces, I'd put the food at about 200 cm³, or about 180-200 g.

The pieces look like cooked chicken breast, which is about 1.65 kcal/g. Most of the mass is chicken, perhaps 150 g, plus about 30 g of onion and carrot.

Energy: chicken about 150 × 1.65 = 248 kcal, vegetables about 12 kcal, total about 260 kcal. If the pieces are tofu, the total would be lower, so I'll settle slightly under the chicken figure.
